There's still a big galaxy out there.|Series Supervising Director [[Dave Filoni]], on the series' [[The Clone Wars: Season Three|Season Three]] finale|{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/season3_finale_weekly/index.html|text=On April 1: The Must-See, Two-Part Season Finale of Star Wars: The Clone Wars|date=2011-03-25}}}} The '''fourth season''' of the animated ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series, marketed under the subtitle '''''Battle Lines''''', began airing on [[Cartoon Network]] in the U.S. on [[September 16]], [[2011]] with a one-hour season premiere and ended with a season finale on [[March 16]], [[2012]]. Much like the previous seasons, the fourth season is comprised of twenty-two episodes.{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/season_4_trailer/index.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Season Four Trailer and Release Date}} The season was first announced in [[April]] [[2010]].{{SWArchive|url=fans/events/star_wars_in_concert_veekhoven/index.html|text=''Star Wars'': In Concert Fan Report from Antwerp}} ==Media== {{Mediacat|from=1|soundcat=Audio files from The Clone Wars: Season Four|imagecat=Images from The Clone Wars: Season Four}} ===Episodes=== {|class="wikitable sortable" {{Prettytable}} |- bgcolor="#CCCCCC" !
